Hi Ava / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo and the thoughtful discussion today — appreciate the clarity on performance targets and the list of internal stakeholders. As promised, I attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft for AuroraTech to this thread. The draft is intentionally lightweight and focused on the milestones we discussed so we can align quickly.

High-level milestones (draft):
- Finalize requirements and success criteria (owner: AuroraTech) — target: 2026-03-18
- Technical spike + PoC on staging (owner: Redwood / AuroraTech) — target: 2026-03-31
- Security & compliance review (SOC2 review + contract redlines) (owner: AuroraTech / Redwood legal) — target: 2026-04-07
- Pilot run / performance validation (owner: Redwood ops / AuroraTech) — target: 2026-04-21
- Contract signature & production rollout (owner: AuroraTech procurement / Redwood sales) — target close: 2026-05-05

Dependencies / open items:
- Access to a representative dataset (AuroraTech)
- Network configuration for private VPC peering (AuroraTech + infra)
- SOC2 artifact exchange and any bespoke controls (AuroraTech security)

Two timeline options (pick one so we can lock calendars):
A) Accelerated — target close 2026-04-21 (requires immediate dataset handoff and expedited SOC2 review)
B) Standard — target close 2026-05-05 (allows one sprint for integration + standard security review cadence)

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholders who should be on the MAP (primary owners for each milestone) and which timeline option you prefer? I’ve cc'd Jordan since he was on the discovery and may help with procurement timelines.

Attachments: AuroraTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP table + milestone rows), Discovery_Notes_20260304.pdf

If it helps I can set up a 30-minute MAP kickoff tomorrow or Friday to walk through the milestones and owners.

Hi Ava / team — quick SOC2 artifact checklist and pilot note below: 

SOC2 artifact checklist (short):
- System description / boundary document (PDF)
- Access control matrix or list of privileged users (CSV/PDF)
- Recent SOC2 report OR list of compensating controls if SOC2 not available
- Network diagram showing VPC boundaries (PNG/PDF)
- Any required encryption/KMS details (short note)

Pilot data scope (min viable subset):
- 10k anonymized records reflective of production schema OR
- A synthetic dataset generated to match schema if data sensitivity prevents sharing
- Sample config for request rates (we typically validate at 50% of projected peak for pilot)
